resources.string: PCI %1$s actually radiates towards sector %2$s. Check the cell-to-sector configuration and the CPRI/fibre connections.
PCI %1$s radiates into sector %2$s on this band only. Check the RRU-to-antenna feeders/jumpers of this band.
The antenna is rotated by %1$s°. Check the azimuth with a compass and set it to the planned %2$s°.
The sector was not heard. Check the cell state (off/locked), RRU, feeder and configuration.
An unplanned PCI was serving near the site. Check the plan or the neighbour site PCI (does not affect the verdict).
Coverage is insufficient. Walk the indicated directions and re-check.
Large azimuth error (%1$s°). Check the antenna direction and the plan.
The estimate is unreliable (methods A and B disagree). A re-check is recommended.
